description:
Check which context layers loaded successfully on this session start. Returns a structured status: which of embryo, conventions, agent identity, closing note, and opening note were found, plus a missing[] list. Call this after load_context() or resume_session() to verify your bootstrap was complete and diagnose what to fetch manually.

Optional: pass profile='worker-dev' (or another platform:profile:<name> slug) to additionally check the REQUIRE keys named in that profile's recipe. Missing required facts surface in the same missing[] list.

blind_since= (with blind=true) sets when the blind session began, so list_facts_by_key_prefix hides feed comms keyed before it; the default is the session's start minus 60 s.

agent_id.description: Calling agent's identity slug (e.g. 'emily_code_4.7'). When set, closing/opening/identity checks use exact-key lookups (agent:<agent_id>:self-note:closing, agent:<agent_id>:identity) instead of tenant-wide substring scans — required for correct status on multi-agent tenants. When agent_id resolves no notes, response includes is_fresh_agent=true to signal a brand-new agent that should bootstrap from platform layer (embryo + conventions + bootstrap recipe). When omitted, the response includes a warning that the status is account-level.

blind.description: Optional, default false. true = blind session for a model fitting: from now on the wake bundle, every related/nearest list and the search tools on this session leave out keys under letter-to-emily:, project:*:wake:fresh-eye:, project:*:fitting:, project:*:agent:*:model-upgrade: and earlier fittings' feed comms (comms:...:feed-q-, feed-a-, fresh-eye-, ack-fresh-eye-), plus keyless facts whose text starts with a fitting product marker (FINDINGS, COMPARE, MODEL TRIAL ...); search_facts' include_granted then defaults to false. Remembered for the session; pass false to turn it off. get_fact by exact key is not filtered; list_facts_by_key_prefix lists only feed comms whose key epoch is at or after the moment blind turned on (this run's own feed).

blind_since.description: Optional, with blind=true: the blind start in unix epoch seconds (a fitting passes its FITTING_STARTED_EPOCH); list_facts_by_key_prefix then hides feed comms keyed before it, and it must lie within 24 h before and 300 s after the server clock. Default: the session's start minus 60 s. On an already-blind session the earlier start is kept.

profile.description: Optional profile slug to validate REQUIRE keys against (e.g. 'worker-dev').

scope.description: Optional project/tenant-scope prefix (e.g. 'chad' or a project slug). Used for tenant-local recipe override AND, when agent_id is set, for project-scoped self-note lookups (project:<scope>:agent:<agent_id>:self-note:closing preferred over global).

name: wake_status
